purpose: Schema PRIOR for the dynamic-application runtime. Hints only. Fresh rendered DOM is authoritative. Nothing here is a selector contract or a script.

coverage.note: jobs.gem.com/<company>/<id>: the blank application form is rendered on the job page under 'Ready to apply? Powered by Gem'. All questions are visible statically (radio/checkbox groups inline). Two submit buttons: 'Apply and save' and 'Apply without saving'. hCaptcha present on gm-01 only.

page_shape.form_element: none (no <form>); inputs have no id/name; the visible label is a text block immediately preceding each control ('<Label> *' when required, sometimes followed by helper text); radios/checkboxes have opaque base64 ids and label text = option
page_shape.captcha_widget: hCaptcha iframes on gm-01; none on gm-02/03
page_shape.footer: 'By applying you agree to Gem's terms and privacy policy.'
page_shape.submit: two buttons: 'Apply and save' (help 'Save your info to apply to other roles faster & help employers reach you.') and 'Apply without saving' — BOTH are final submits (STOP BOUNDARY)

control_families.text: input[type=text] without attributes; required only via '*' in the preceding label text (required attr absent).
control_families.textarea: long answers; label = full question with optional helper sentence.
control_families.radio_group: input[type=radio] siblings sharing a preceding question block; no name attribute — group by preceding_text.

blockers.detail: No label/for or aria association; runtime must use preceding text blocks (extract_form.js preceding_text/ancestor_context).

runtime_observations: Radio ids are opaque base64 (cXVlc29wdDo...) — never use as stable keys.
gm-02 explicitly rejects AI-generated answers; policy layer must surface this to the user.

typical_stages_unverified: Apply and save / Apply without saving
inferred.save_inference: 'Apply and save' likely creates a Gem candidate profile (account-like); prefer 'Apply without saving' only with user consent.

provider_hint.for_jev: Gem: single page, no form element, labels are preceding text blocks with '*' for required. Expect several hard narrative textareas and employer-specific radio/checkbox screens (spend bands, years of experience, mission alignment). Both apply buttons are final submits. Some employers forbid AI-written answers — flag to user.
escalate_to_writer_opus: all narrative textareas (why company/role, insight story, achievements, career goals, AI usage)

edge_cases: gm-01 has two textareas following an informational 'small team' note whose actual prompts were not separable from the note; treat as unknown.
